setup.label: Stripe
setup.keyHint: Starts with sk_test_ or sk_live_. Try a test key first.

setup.label: HubSpot
setup.keyHint: Create a private app with the CRM scopes you need.

setup.label: Shopify
setup.keyHint: From a custom app in your store admin. Starts with shpat_. Every call also sends "shop": your store name before .myshopify.com.

setup.label: PayPal
setup.usernameHint: From the PayPal developer dashboard, Apps & Credentials (Live). AgentRaaS gets a fresh access token itself when the old one expires.

setup.label: Slack
setup.keyHint: Starts with xoxb-. Invite the bot to the channel.

setup.label: Resend
setup.keyHint: Starts with re_. Send from a domain you verified in Resend.

setup.label: SendGrid
setup.keyHint: Starts with SG. and needs Mail Send access.

setup.label: GitHub
setup.keyHint: Give it Issues: read and write on the repositories your agent uses.

setup.label: Notion
setup.keyHint: Starts with ntn_. Share the page or database with the integration.

setup.label: Jira
setup.usernameHint: The email you log in to Jira with

fields.description: The agent's refund call returned a card_declined error.

setup.label: Alpaca (paper trading)
setup.usernameHint: From the Paper Trading account in the Alpaca dashboard. Paper keys only work here.

setup.label: Alpaca (live trading)
setup.usernameHint: From the Live account. Real money: try alpaca_paper first and add approval rules.

setup.label: Upstox
setup.keyHint: Expires at 3:30 AM the next day: save a new one every trading day. Orders must come from the static IP registered on your Upstox app.

setup.label: Dhan
setup.keyHint: Valid for 24 hours: save a new one every trading day. Every order also sends your dhanClientId. Orders must come from the static IP set on your Dhan account.

setup.label: Cashfree Payments
setup.usernameHint: From the Cashfree merchant dashboard, Developers, API keys (production).

setup.label: Cashfree Payments (test)
setup.usernameHint: Test-mode keys from the Cashfree merchant dashboard. Nothing real is charged or refunded.

setup.label: RazorpayX Payouts
setup.usernameHint: API keys from RazorpayX (test keys start with rzp_test_). Every payout gets an idempotency key, which RazorpayX requires.

setup.label: Gupshup (WhatsApp)
setup.keyHint: From your Gupshup account. Send from the WhatsApp number and app registered there.

setup.label: Delhivery
setup.keyHint: From Delhivery One, Settings, API setup. shipment.create sends format "json" and data: the shipments JSON as a string.

setup.label: Delhivery (test)
setup.keyHint: A staging token from Delhivery. Nothing is picked up or shipped.

setup.label: MSG91 (SMS)
setup.keyHint: From the MSG91 panel, Authkey. Sends a DLT-approved template. MSG91 answers success before it checks the key, so a wrong key shows up only in MSG91's delivery reports.

setup.label: PayPal (test)
setup.usernameHint: Sandbox app credentials from the PayPal developer dashboard. Nothing real is charged.

setup.label: PhonePe (test)
setup.usernameHint: PhonePe UAT (sandbox) credentials. AgentRaaS gets a fresh token itself when the old one expires. Amounts are in paise.

setup.label: Shiprocket
setup.usernameHint: An API user (Settings, API, Configure, not your panel login). AgentRaaS logs in itself and renews the token every 10 days.
